summary: Plan a2-note-rename-plan halted at deploy_new. Earlier stages (expand_add_col, expand_backfill) passed. Deploy_new failed because the new app's Django migration attempted to add the customer_note column, which already existed from the plan's ALTER TABLE, raising "column already exists" error. Root cause: the plan assumed the new app's migration is state-only (per problem statement), but the migration actually issues ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN, creating a schema conflict. Revision needed: plan must account for migration DDL, either by omitting expand_add_col and relying on migration, or by adjusting the migration to be truly state-only.
revision_notes: Root cause: The plan's expand_add_col stage added the customer_note column via ALTER TABLE. When deploy_new executed, the new app's Django migration (intended to be state-only per problem facts) ran and attempted to add the same column, causing a PostgreSQL ProgrammingError. The plan did not anticipate that the migration would issue DDL, conflicting with the pre-existing column. Revised approach: set repeat_until_zero_rows=false for backfill (already done), and restructure stages so that either the plan's ALTER TABLE is omitted and the migration adds the column, or the migration is made state-only via a custom SQL that checks for existence before adding. Given the problem facts state the migration is state-only, the most consistent revision is to remove expand_add_col and allow the migration to create the column during deploy_new, then proceed with backfill and contract_drop.

stages.description: Backfill customer_note from note for existing rows (only old app active)
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE note IS NOT NULL;

stages.description: Deploy new-staged version; Django migration (state-only) creates customer_note column; code already references customer_note
Remove obsolete note column after old version retired
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;

stages.description: Retire old version; ensures no further writes to note column
